rules.title: Native controls
rules.rule: Actions are <button>, navigation is <a href>; never a <div> or <span> with onClick.

rules.title: Interactive roles need keyboard
rules.rule: An element with an interactive ARIA role implements that role's full keyboard model.

rules.title: No redundant roles
rules.rule: Do not add a role that repeats native semantics (<button role="button">).

rules.title: No aria-label on generic elements
rules.rule: Never put aria-label on a <div> or <span> with no role.

rules.title: ARIA references resolve
rules.rule: aria-labelledby and aria-describedby point at IDs that exist.

rules.title: Navigation is not a menu
rules.rule: Site navigation is <nav> with a list, never role="menu".

rules.title: One disabled mechanism
rules.rule: Never set both disabled and aria-disabled; aria-disabled controls block activation in code.

rules.title: No tooltip on disabled controls
rules.rule: A natively disabled control carries no tooltip; show the reason as text or use aria-disabled.

rules.title: Style :focus-visible
rules.rule: Style focus with :focus-visible, not bare :focus.

rules.title: Visible focus
rules.rule: Every keyboard-reachable control shows a visible focus indicator.
rules.notes: DS tokens border.width.focus (2px) and focus.ring.offset (2px) already match the magazine's 2px/2px.

rules.title: Forced-colors edges
rules.rule: Focus and control edges stay visible in forced-colors mode.

rules.title: Focus not obscured
rules.rule: A focused element is never fully hidden behind sticky headers, footers or banners.

rules.title: Sticky header offset
rules.rule: With a sticky header, anchors and focused elements land below it (scroll-padding-block-start or scroll-margin-block-start equal to its height).

rules.title: Keyboard path for everything
rules.rule: Every pointer interaction has a keyboard path; the whole interface works from the keyboard.

rules.title: Escape closes overlays
rules.rule: Escape closes the most recently opened overlay (tooltip, then menu, then dialog).

rules.title: No positive tabindex
rules.rule: Never use tabindex above 0.

rules.title: Composite widgets are one Tab stop
rules.rule: Tabs, menus, toolbars and radio groups occupy one Tab stop.

rules.title: APG key map
rules.rule: Custom composite widgets implement the APG keys: arrows move, Home/End jump, Enter/Space activate.

rules.title: Dialog focus
rules.rule: Dialogs make the background inert, move focus inside on open and return it to the trigger on close.

rules.title: Dialog semantics
rules.rule: A custom overlay has role=dialog, aria-modal=true and a name, or is a native <dialog>.

rules.title: Headless primitives for overlays
rules.rule: Build dialogs, selects and menus on a headless primitive (Base UI or Radix), not from scratch.

rules.title: Safe default focus
rules.rule: A destructive confirmation focuses the least destructive action on open.

rules.title: Route change focus and title
rules.rule: On a client-side route change, update document.title and move focus to the new view's <h1> or <main>.

rules.title: Specific title first
rules.rule: <title> names the current context, most specific first (Billing · Settings · App).

rules.title: Decorative layers pass clicks
rules.rule: Decorative overlays (glows, scrims, full-bleed ::after) have pointer-events: none.

rules.title: Drag has a single-pointer alternative
rules.rule: Every drag (block reorder, resize) has a click or keyboard alternative.

rules.title: Inputs have labels
rules.rule: Every input has a programmatic label; a placeholder never stands in for one.

rules.title: Autocomplete tokens
rules.rule: Fields about the user carry a valid autocomplete token.

rules.title: Right input type
rules.rule: Inputs use the matching type, and spellcheck=false on emails, codes and usernames.
rules.notes: The inputmode (mobile keyboard) half is dropped for desktop.

rules.title: Never block paste
rules.rule: Never block paste into a field.

rules.title: Validate on submit
rules.rule: Validate on submit; never natively disable submit to gate validation (use aria-disabled plus a handler guard when a step needs input).
rules.notes: Conflict: issue 12 keeps Continue disabled until input. Resolved to the skill's stricter rule with aria-disabled.

rules.title: Errors are announced
rules.rule: Failing fields get aria-invalid=true and aria-describedby to inline error text, and focus moves to the first invalid field.

rules.title: No keystroke filtering
rules.rule: Accept free text and validate after; never block or filter characters while typing.

rules.title: Pending submit
rules.rule: While submitting, show a spinner beside the original label and mark the button aria-disabled.

rules.title: Unsaved changes
rules.rule: Warn on unsaved changes before navigation; re-renders never reset typed values or steal focus.

rules.title: Every control has a name
rules.rule: Every interactive control, icon-only ones included, has an accessible name.

rules.title: Visible label in the name
rules.rule: The visible label appears in the accessible name, ideally at its start; no aria-label where visible text already names the control.

rules.title: aria-hidden is not focusable
rules.rule: aria-hidden is never on or above a focusable element.

rules.title: Pause moving content
rules.rule: Anything moving or auto-updating for more than 5s has a visible pause control.

rules.title: Toast timing
rules.rule: Toasts with an action or error stay until dismissed; timed toasts last 5s or more and pause on hover or focus.

rules.title: Polite status announcements
rules.rule: Status changes without a focus move (copied, saved) go through a polite live region rendered empty before the update.

rules.title: Assertive only when urgent
rules.rule: role=alert or aria-live=assertive only for urgent errors; success and status use role=status.

rules.title: Never focus a toast
rules.rule: Never move focus to a toast.

rules.title: Images have alt
rules.rule: Every has an alt attribute.

rules.title: SVG semantics
rules.rule: Decorative SVGs and icons inside labelled controls are aria-hidden; meaningful standalone SVGs have role=img and a name.

rules.title: Media captions
rules.rule: Prerecorded video has captions, audio a transcript, and nothing autoplays with sound.

rules.title: One main
rules.rule: Expose exactly one visible primary <main> landmark.

rules.title: Skip link
rules.rule: When repeated navigation precedes <main>, a skip link is the first focusable element.

rules.title: Heading outline
rules.rule: Headings describe their sections and form a coherent outline.

rules.title: Labelled landmarks
rules.rule: Several landmarks of one type carry distinguishing labels.

rules.title: rem media queries
rules.rule: Write media queries in rem or em.

rules.title: Toggle state exposed
rules.rule: Tab and toggle buttons expose aria-pressed or aria-selected; non-submit buttons have type=button.

rules.title: lang and dir
rules.rule: Set lang on the document and dir wherever direction changes.

rules.title: Prefer delete
rules.rule: When code adds what deletion would fix (redundant ARIA, a separator space would carry), that is a finding.

rules.title: No removed signals
rules.rule: A change never removes accessibility, motion, direction or typography signals.

rules.title: Accessibility is release work
rules.rule: Accessibility issues are release work.
rules.notes: Process rule; the a11y rules above carry the checks.
